Hi Ben —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so the security team has what they need to move us through procurement: 

Key items we discussed:
- Scope: admin activity (console/admin UI), API request/response logs, and model invocation metadata (timestamps, model version, token counts).
- Exportability: you need scheduled exports + on-demand exports in a standard newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) format, minimally covering 90 days, with options for longer retention to S3.
- Immutability/forensics: requirement to show an append-only audit trail and tamper-evidence for a 7 year retention scenario.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II coverage and HIPAA support for BAA-required controls.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I will route your questionnaire and audit-log-specific asks to our security/infra leads for answers and examples.
2) We will send an initial packet (redacted SOC 2, export playbook, and a small sample export) by Wednesday.
3) If that looks good, schedule a short technical deep-dive (30–45 min) between your security engineers and our infra team.

Anything missing or misaligned from your side?

—Stephanie

Thanks, Stephanie — that matches our notes. A few clarifying questions from our InfoSec team: 

1) SOC 2: can you confirm the scope includes the control plane and the hosted API endpoints? We will need a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and your point-of-contact for a bridge call.

2) HIPAA / BAA: we handle PHI in downstream systems. Does Redwood offer a BAA and do you have HIPAA specific logging controls?

3) Export format & delivery: NDJSON is fine. Can exports be scheduled daily and delivered to our S3 bucket (we can provide a bucket ARN) with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS)? Also need clarity on incremental exports vs full snapshots and if you support continuity tokens for resumed exports.

4) Immutability: we need an explanation of how you achieve tamper-evidence. Is this through a write-once store, cryptographic chaining, or WORM storage options?

5) Can you start a vendor security questionnaire in parallel? I will attach our standard questionnaire to this thread separately.

If you can get those answers and sample export artifacts by Wednesday EOD PDT that would keep us on schedule.

-Ben

Hi team —

Draft answers & artifacts below. I kept technical details concise for the customer; happy to expand for Ben's infra folks in the deep-dive.

1) SOC 2: Marissa will attach the redacted report and be the primary contact for the bridge call (marissa_cole@redwood.ai).

2) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads under a signed BAA. We have controls for PHI access logging and separate data handling controls; Marissa will include legal contact.

3) Export format & delivery:
- Format: NDJSON (one JSON object per line). We also produce CSV for select admin events on request.
- Delivery: daily scheduled exports to customer-owned S3 (ARN accepted). We support SSE-KMS; customer supplies KMS key.
- Incremental vs snapshot: exports are incremental deltas by default (events since last export) with an option to request a full snapshot. Each export includes a continuity token (cursor) so resumable transfers are straightforward.
- Throughput: typical daily export for high-activity customers ~1–4 GB/day per 100k invocations; we can provide a sample small export attached.

4) Immutability / tamper evidence:
- Primary: we maintain an append-only event ledger for admin and API events in our internal storage layer. Events are written with monotonically increasing sequence numbers and SHA-256 hashes salted by a server-side secret.
- Optional WORM: for customers that need legal WORM, we can push exports to immutable storage buckets or a vendor-managed WORM archive (configurable).
- Audit trail: all export deliveries include a manifest file listing sequence ranges and cryptographic hashes; we can provide verification scripts.

5) Sample artifacts attached: redacted SOC 2, activity export playbook, and a small NDJSON sample (first 500 events).

Recommended next steps for Ben:
- Send S3 bucket ARN and preferred KMS key alias for a test export.
- Schedule 30–45 minute deep-dive (infra + security).
- We will provision a test export and a verification manifest within 48–72 hours after getting bucket access.

Let me know if you want more detail on hash chaining or storage backends — happy to expand in the technical call.

—Rishi
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
